description: NaMg₃₀BO₃₁ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pmm2 space group. Na is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to three O atoms. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-1°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.09-2.16 Å.
